title: Create++
description: The Ultimate modpack for a Create mod lover and its made with love!
body:
It is the Ultimate modpack for a Create mod lover, this mod has such mods like Create: Aeronautics, Create: Big Cannons and Create: Radars to make battles with your friends on a server!

Recomended specs:
- CPU: Ryzen 7 5800H
- GPU: RTX 3050 12 VRAM
- RAM: 16GB
